verdict.rationale: Fin/Intercom offers some data-access mechanisms — exporting a saved View (docs-2) and a public REST API/webhooks that let a customer pull their own data programmatically (docs-3, probe-rt-2, docs-6) — but there is no documented bulk 'export all your data' feature, no stated open-format (CSV/JSON) full-account export, and no migration/exit tooling. Missing for 10: an explicit full-account data export feature, documented open export formats, and any GDPR/data-portability or account-closure export tool.
